name: app.R
content:
# SAIC50 — Concentración inhibitoria media / Half maximal inhibitory concentration
# Sección de Apoyo Estadístico (SAI), Universidad de Murcia.
# Versión modernizada (bslib / Bootstrap 5, ggplot2, sesiones aisladas, ES/EN).
# Las funciones de R/ se cargan automáticamente al arrancar la app.

library(shiny)
library(bslib)

theme <- bs_theme(
  version = 5, bootswatch = "flatly",
  primary = "#ae1b2d", secondary = "#222222",
  "navbar-bg" = "#222222", "link-color" = "#ae1b2d", "link-hover-color" = "#76121c",
  base_font = font_collection("system-ui", "-apple-system", "Segoe UI", "Roboto", "sans-serif")
)

ui <- page_sidebar(
  title = div(
    class = "d-flex align-items-center w-100",
    tags$img(src = "logo-simbolo.jpg", height = "36px", class = "me-2"),
    i18n("app_title"),
    actionButton("lang_toggle", tagList(icon("globe"), i18n("lang_switch")),
                 class = "btn-sm btn-outline-light ms-auto",
                 title = "Español / English")
  ),
  theme = theme,
  window_title = "SAIC50",
  sidebar = sidebar(
    width = 340,
    fileInput("file", i18n("file_label"),
              accept = c(".csv", ".txt", ".tsv", "text/csv", "text/plain"),
              buttonLabel = i18n("browse"), placeholder = TR_ES$no_file),
    div(class = "d-flex gap-2 small",
        actionLink("ex1", i18n("use_ex1")), "·", actionLink("ex2", i18n("use_ex2"))),
    radioButtons("method", i18n("method"),
                 choiceNames = lapply(paste0("m", 1:5, "_short"), i18n),
                 choiceValues = as.character(1:5), selected = "5"),
    downloadButton("download", i18n("download"), class = "btn-primary"),
    hr(),
    div(class = "small text-muted",
        tags$a(href = "https://www.um.es/web/sai/", target = "_blank", i18n("sai")), br(),
        i18n("um"), br(),
        tags$a(href = "mailto:aurora.gonzalez2@um.es", "aurora.gonzalez2@um.es"), br(),
        tags$a(href = "mailto:amaurandi@um.es", "amaurandi@um.es"), br(),
        tags$a(href = "mailto:antoniojose.peran@um.es", "antoniojose.peran@um.es"), br(),
        APP_VERSION, " · ",
        tags$a(href = paste0("https://doi.org/", APP_DOI), target = "_blank",
               paste0("DOI: ", APP_DOI)))
  ),
  tags$head(tags$script(src = "i18n.js")),
  navset_card_underline(
    id = "tabs",
    nav_panel(i18n("tab_results"), value = "results", uiOutput("results")),
    nav_panel(i18n("tab_data"), value = "data", uiOutput("data_info"), tableOutput("data_table")),
    nav_panel(i18n("tab_methods"), value = "methods", withMathJax(i18n("methods_html", div))),
    nav_panel(i18n("tab_help"), value = "help", i18n("help_html", div))
  )
)

server <- function(input, output, session) {
  # ---- Idioma ---------------------------------------------------------------
  lang <- reactiveVal("es")

  # Idioma inicial: ?lang=en|es en la URL o, si no, el del navegador.
  observeEvent(input$browser_lang, once = TRUE, {
    q <- parseQueryString(session$clientData$url_search)$lang
    lang(if (!is.null(q) && q %in% LANGS) q
         else if (input$browser_lang %in% c("es", "ca", "gl", "eu")) "es" else "en")
  })
  observeEvent(input$lang_toggle, lang(setdiff(LANGS, lang())))
  observe(session$sendCustomMessage("set-lang", list(lang = lang(), dict = i18n_dict())))

  # ---- Datos y cálculo -------------------------------------------------------
  data_path <- reactiveVal(NULL)

  observeEvent(input$file, data_path(list(path = input$file$datapath, name = input$file$name)))
  observeEvent(input$ex1, data_path(list(path = "www/realdata.csv", name = "realdata.csv")))
  observeEvent(input$ex2, data_path(list(path = "www/testdata.csv", name = "testdata.csv")))

  dat <- reactive({
    req(data_path())
    l <- lang()
    tryCatch(read_ic50_data(data_path()$path, l),
             error = function(e) validate(paste(tr("err_read", l), conditionMessage(e))))
  })

  res <- reactive({
    d <- dat()
    tryCatch(compute_ic50(d, input$method, lang()),
             error = function(e) validate(paste(tr("err_fit", lang()), conditionMessage(e))))
  })

  plot_obj <- reactive(plot_ic50(res(), lang()))

  # ---- Salidas ----------------------------------------------------------------
  output$results <- renderUI({
    l <- lang()
    if (is.null(data_path())) {
      return(div(class = "p-4 text-center text-muted",
                 tags$h4(tr("welcome_title", l)),
                 p(tr("welcome_text", l))))
    }
    r <- res()
    tagList(
      layout_column_wrap(
        width = 1/3, fill = FALSE,
        value_box("IC50", format(signif(r$ic50, 5)), theme = "primary"),
        value_box("R²", sprintf("%.4f", r$stats$r2)),
        value_box(tr("vb_obs", l), sprintf("%d / %d", sum(r$used), length(r$used)))
      ),
      plotOutput("plot", height = "460px"),
      accordion(open = FALSE,
        accordion_panel(tr("fit_detail", l), verbatimTextOutput("summary")))
    )
  })

  output$plot <- renderPlot(plot_obj(), res = 96)
  output$summary <- renderText(report_text(res(), data_path()$name, lang()))

  output$data_info <- renderUI({
    l <- lang()
    if (is.null(data_path())) return(p(class = "text-muted", tr("no_data", l)))
    d <- dat(); f <- attr(d, "format")
    p(class = "text-muted small",
      tr("data_info", l, data_path()$name, nrow(d),
         if (f$sep == "\t") "\\t" else f$sep, f$dec))
  })
  output$data_table <- renderTable(dat(), digits = 4, striped = TRUE, hover = TRUE)

  output$download <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() tr("f_zip", lang(), input$method, format(Sys.Date())),
    content = function(file) {
      dir <- tempfile("saic50-")
      dir.create(dir)
      on.exit(unlink(dir, recursive = TRUE))
      l <- lang()
      r <- res()
      m <- input$method
      ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(dir, tr("f_plot", l, m)), plot_obj(),
                      width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 150, bg = "white")
      writeLines(report_text(r, data_path()$name, l),
                 file.path(dir, tr("f_report", l, m)), useBytes = TRUE)
      used <- r$data[, c("x", "y", "z", "t")]
      used[[tr("col_used", l)]] <- r$used
      write_fun <- if (l == "es") utils::write.csv2 else utils::write.csv
      write_fun(used, file.path(dir, tr("f_data", l, m)), row.names = FALSE)
      zip::zip(file, files = list.files(dir), root = dir)
    },
    contentType = "application/zip"
  )
}

shinyApp(ui, server)

IC50 is recalculated automatically when the method is changed.", vb_obs = "Observations used", fit_detail = "Fit details", no_data = "No data loaded yet.", data_info = "%s · %d observations · separator '%s' · decimal '%s'", err_read = "Could not read the file:", err_fit = "Could not fit the model:", err_empty = "The file is empty.", err_cols = "At least two columns are required (concentration x and inhibition y).", err_nobs = "There are fewer than 3 valid numeric observations.", ax_x = "Concentration (x)", ax_z = "log(concentration) z = log(x)", ax_y = "Inhibition (%) y", ax_t = "t = log(y / (100 - y))", used = "Used in fit", excluded = "Excluded", rep_file = "Data file:", rep_used = "Observations used: %d of %d", rep_model = "Regression model:", rep_footer = "Statistical Support Section (SAI), University of Murcia", f_zip = "SAIC50-method%s-%s.zip", f_plot = "plot-method%s.png", f_report = "results-method%s.txt", f_data = "data-method%s.csv", col_used = "used", methods_html = '

Method 1: simple linear regression

A line \\(y = a x + b\\) is fitted between concentration and inhibition and solved for the concentration at 50% inhibition: \\(IC_{50} = \\frac{50 - b}{a}\\).

Method 2: log-transformed x-axis

With \\(z = \\log x\\), we fit \\(y = a z + b\\); then \\(z = \\frac{50 - b}{a}\\) and \\(IC_{50} = e^{z}\\). Zero concentrations are discarded (they have no logarithm).

Method 3: transformation of both axes

With \\(z = \\log x\\) and \\(t = \\log\\frac{y}{100 - y}\\), we fit \\(t = a z + b\\). Since \\(y = 50 \\Rightarrow t = \\log 1 = 0\\), \\(z = -\\frac{b}{a}\\) and \\(IC_{50} = e^{z}\\). Only observations with \\(x > 0\\) and \\(0 < y < 100\\) are used.

Method 4: Method 3 removing observations

The observations at the extreme (minimum or maximum of \\(y\\)) farthest from 50 are successively removed, up to 25% of the data, and the subset whose fit has the highest \\(R^2\\) is chosen. IC50 is calculated as in Method 3. In the plot, discarded observations appear in gray.

Method 5 (recommended): 4-parameter logistic regression (4PL)

The sigmoid curve \\(y = A + \\frac{B - A}{1 + e^{(x_{mid} - z)/s}}\\) with \\(z = \\log x\\) is fitted by nonlinear least squares, where \\(A\\) and \\(B\\) are the asymptotes, \\(x_{mid}\\) is the inflection point and \\(1/s\\) is the Hill slope. This is the log-logistic (Hill) model commonly used for dose-response curves. The IC50 is the concentration at which the curve equals 50: \\(IC_{50} = \\exp\\left(x_{mid} - s\\,\\log\\left(\\frac{B-A}{50-A} - 1\\right)\\right)\\). The report also gives the relative IC50, \\(e^{x_{mid}}\\), the concentration halfway between the asymptotes. Starting values come from Method 3, which is the linearization of this model with \\(A = 0\\) and \\(B = 100\\). At least 5 observations with \\(x > 0\\) are required.

References

  1. How to calculate IC50 (2014). Sciencegateway.org (original link no longer available).
  2. ANIARA (2009). Parameter Cytotoxicity Kit. ICT-CVDE kit technical documentation.
  3. Maurandi López, A.; del Río Alonso, L.; Balsalobre Rodríguez, C. (2013). Fundamentos estadísticos para investigación. Introducción a R. Bubok.
  4. James, G.; Witten, D.; Hastie, T.; Tibshirani, R. (2021). An Introduction to Statistical Learning. 2nd ed. Springer.

name: R/ic50_methods.R
content:
APP_VERSION <- "v5.0"
APP_DOI <- "10.5281/zenodo.24106193"

# Métodos de cálculo del IC50. Los métodos 1-4 reproducen numéricamente f.ic50m01..04.r
# (verificado en tests/test_methods.R) pero sin efectos secundarios: cada
# método devuelve una lista con el ajuste, el IC50 y los datos usados.

logit100 <- function(y) log(y / (100 - y))

# Datos transformados para los métodos 2-4. 'keep' marca las filas utilizables
# (x > 0 para el logaritmo; 0 < y < 100 para el logit).
transform_data <- function(df) {
  df$z <- ifelse(df$x > 0, log(df$x), NA_real_)
  df$t <- suppressWarnings(logit100(df$y))
  df
}

fit_stats <- function(fit) {
  r <- stats::residuals(fit)
  rmse <- sqrt(mean(r^2))
  mae <- mean(abs(r))
  y <- stats::fitted(fit) + r
  # R^2 = 1 - SCR/SCT (en lm coincide con summary(fit)$r.squared; en nls es
  # el pseudo-R^2 habitual)
  r2 <- 1 - sum(r^2) / sum((y - mean(y))^2)
  list(r2 = r2, rmse = rmse, mae = mae, rmse_mae = rmse / mae)
}

ic50_m1 <- function(df) {
  fit <- stats::lm(y ~ x, data = df)
  cf <- stats::coef(fit)
  list(method = 1, fit = fit, ic50 = unname((50 - cf[1]) / cf[2]),
       used = rep(TRUE, nrow(df)), xvar = "x", yvar = "y", target = 50)
}

ic50_m2 <- function(df) {
  df <- transform_data(df)
  used <- is.finite(df$z)
  fit <- stats::lm(y ~ z, data = df[used, ])
  cf <- stats::coef(fit)
  list(method = 2, fit = fit, ic50 = unname(exp((50 - cf[1]) / cf[2])),
       used = used, xvar = "z", yvar = "y", target = 50)
}

ic50_m3 <- function(df) {
  df <- transform_data(df)
  used <- is.finite(df$z) & is.finite(df$t)
  fit <- stats::lm(t ~ z, data = df[used, ])
  cf <- stats::coef(fit)
  list(method = 3, fit = fit, ic50 = unname(exp(-cf[1] / cf[2])),
       used = used, xvar = "z", yvar = "t", target = 0)
}

# Método 4: partiendo de los datos del método 3, se elimina iterativamente la
# observación (o empates) con la y más alejada de 50 entre el mínimo y el
# máximo, hasta un 25 % de las observaciones, y se elige el subconjunto con
# mayor R^2.
ic50_m4 <- function(df) {
  df <- transform_data(df)
  df$row <- seq_len(nrow(df))
  cur <- df[is.finite(df$z) & is.finite(df$t), ]
  n_iter <- max(1L, as.integer(25 * nrow(cur) / 100))

  r2 <- numeric(0)
  subsets <- list()
  for (i in seq_len(n_iter)) {
    if (nrow(cur) < 3) break
    r2 <- c(r2, summary(stats::lm(t ~ z, data = cur))$r.squared)
    subsets <- c(subsets, list(cur$row))
    far <- if (abs(50 - min(cur$y)) > abs(50 - max(cur$y))) min(cur$y) else max(cur$y)
    cur <- cur[cur$y != far, ]
  }
  best <- subsets[[which.max(r2)]]
  used <- df$row %in% best
  fit <- stats::lm(t ~ z, data = df[used, ])
  cf <- stats::coef(fit)
  list(method = 4, fit = fit, ic50 = unname(exp(-cf[1] / cf[2])),
       used = used, xvar = "z", yvar = "t", target = 0,
       r2_path = r2)
}

# Método 5: regresión logística de 4 parámetros (4PL) en z = log(x):
#   y = A + (B - A) / (1 + exp((xmid - z) / scal))
# equivalente al modelo log-logístico de Hill con pendiente 1/scal. El método 3
# es su linealización con asíntotas fijas A = 0 y B = 100, así que su ajuste
# proporciona los valores iniciales (xmid = -b/a, scal = 1/a). El IC50
# (absoluto) es la concentración con y = 50; exp(xmid) es el IC50 relativo
# (punto de inflexión, a medio camino entre las asíntotas).
fpl <- function(z, A, B, xmid, scal) A + (B - A) / (1 + exp((xmid - z) / scal))

fpl_starts <- function(d) {
  starts <- list()
  m3 <- tryCatch(stats::coef(stats::lm(t ~ z, data = d[is.finite(d$t), ])),
                 error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(m3) && all(is.finite(m3)) && m3[2] != 0)
    starts <- c(starts, list(list(A = 0, B = 100, xmid = unname(-m3[1] / m3[2]),
                                  scal = unname(1 / m3[2]))))
  # Alternativa heurística: asíntotas en el rango observado
  sgn <- if (stats::cor(d$z, d$y) < 0) -1 else 1
  starts <- c(starts, list(list(A = min(d$y), B = max(d$y), xmid = stats::median(d$z),
                                scal = sgn * stats::sd(d$z) / 2)))
  starts
}

ic50_m5 <- function(df, lang = "es") {
  df <- transform_data(df)
  used <- is.finite(df$z)
  d <- df[used, ]
  if (nrow(d) < 5) stop(tr("err_4pl_n", lang), call. = FALSE)

  fit <- NULL
  for (st in fpl_starts(d)) {
    for (alg in c("default", "port")) {
      fit <- tryCatch(stats::nls(y ~ fpl(z, A, B, xmid, scal), data = d, start = st,
                                 algorithm = alg,
                                 control = stats::nls.control(maxiter = 500)),
                      error = function(e) NULL)
      if (!is.null(fit)) break
    }
    if (!is.null(fit)) break
  }
  if (is.null(fit)) stop(tr("err_4pl_fit", lang), call. = FALSE)

  cf <- stats::coef(fit)
  ratio <- (cf[["B"]] - cf[["A"]]) / (50 - cf[["A"]]) - 1
  if (!is.finite(ratio) || ratio <= 0) stop(tr("err_4pl_range", lang), call. = FALSE)
  ic50 <- exp(cf[["xmid"]] - cf[["scal"]] * log(ratio))

  list(method = 5, fit = fit, ic50 = ic50, used = used,
       xvar = "z", yvar = "y", target = 50, curve = TRUE,
       params = c(cf, hill = 1 / cf[["scal"]]), ic50_rel = exp(cf[["xmid"]]))
}

compute_ic50 <- function(df, method, lang = "es") {
  res <- switch(as.character(method),
                "1" = ic50_m1(df), "2" = ic50_m2(df),
                "3" = ic50_m3(df), "4" = ic50_m4(df),
                "5" = ic50_m5(df, lang),
                stop("Método desconocido: ", method))
  res$data <- transform_data(df)
  res$stats <- fit_stats(res$fit)
  res
}

# Gráfico (ggplot2) e informe de texto descargable, en el idioma indicado.

method_label <- function(method, lang = "es") tr(paste0("m", method), lang)

plot_ic50 <- function(res, lang = "es") {
  lab_used <- tr("used", lang)
  lab_excl <- tr("excluded", lang)
  d <- res$data
  d$px <- d[[res$xvar]]
  d$py <- d[[res$yvar]]
  d$estado <- factor(ifelse(res$used, lab_used, lab_excl), levels = c(lab_used, lab_excl))
  d <- d[is.finite(d$px) & is.finite(d$py), ]

  cf <- stats::coef(res$fit)
  x50 <- if (res$xvar == "x") res$ic50 else log(res$ic50)
  if (isTRUE(res$curve)) {
    num <- function(v) { v <- signif(v, 3); if (v < 0) sprintf("(%s)", v) else as.character(v) }
    eq <- sprintf("y = %s + (%s - %s) / (1 + exp((%s - z) / %s))",
                  num(cf[["A"]]), num(cf[["B"]]), num(cf[["A"]]), num(cf[["xmid"]]),
                  num(cf[["scal"]]))
    zz <- seq(min(d$px), max(d$px), length.out = 300)
    curve <- data.frame(px = zz, py = fpl(zz, cf[["A"]], cf[["B"]], cf[["xmid"]], cf[["scal"]]))
    fit_layer <- ggplot2::geom_line(data = curve, colour = "#2c6fbb", linewidth = 1.2)
  } else {
    eq <- sprintf("%s = %.4f · %s %s %.4f", res$yvar, cf[2], res$xvar,
                  if (cf[1] < 0) "-" else "+", abs(cf[1]))
    fit_layer <- ggplot2::geom_abline(intercept = cf[1], slope = cf[2],
                                      colour = "#2c6fbb", linewidth = 1.2)
  }

  ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(px, py)) +
    fit_layer +
    ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = res$target, colour = "#2e9d5b",
                        linetype = "dashed") +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = x50, colour = "#2e9d5b", linetype = "dashed") +
    ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(colour = estado, shape = estado), size = 2.8) +
    ggplot2::annotate("point", x = x50, y = res$target, size = 4.5,
                      colour = "#2e9d5b") +
    ggplot2::scale_colour_manual(values = stats::setNames(c("#ae1b2d", "grey60"),
                                                          c(lab_used, lab_excl)), drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::scale_shape_manual(values = stats::setNames(c(19, 4), c(lab_used, lab_excl)),
                                drop = FALSE) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = tr(paste0("ax_", res$xvar), lang),
                  y = tr(paste0("ax_", res$yvar), lang),
                  title = sprintf("IC50 = %s", format(signif(res$ic50, 5))),
                  subtitle = paste0(method_label(res$method, lang), "\n", eq),
                  colour = NULL, shape = NULL) +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    ggplot2::theme(legend.position = if (any(d$estado == lab_excl)) "bottom" else "none",
                   plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"))
}

report_text <- function(res, file_name = NULL, lang = "es", version = APP_VERSION) {
  s <- res$stats
  # La salida de summary(lm) usa el idioma de R: se fija al de la interfaz.
  old <- Sys.setLanguage(lang)
  on.exit(Sys.setLanguage(old), add = TRUE)
  model_out <- utils::capture.output(print(summary(res$fit)))

  out <- c(
    sprintf("SAIC50 %s (https://doi.org/%s), %s", version, APP_DOI, format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")),
    strrep("-", 60),
    if (!is.null(file_name)) paste(tr("rep_file", lang), file_name),
    method_label(res$method, lang),
    "",
    sprintf("IC50      = %s", format(res$ic50, digits = 8)),
    sprintf("R^2       = %.6f", s$r2),
    sprintf("RMSE      = %.6f", s$rmse),
    sprintf("MAE       = %.6f", s$mae),
    sprintf("RMSE/MAE  = %.6f", s$rmse_mae),
    if (!is.null(res$ic50_rel)) tr("rep_rel", lang, format(res$ic50_rel, digits = 8)),
    if (!is.null(res$params)) tr("rep_hill", lang, format(res$params[["hill"]], digits = 6)),
    tr("rep_used", lang, sum(res$used), length(res$used)),
    "",
    tr("rep_model", lang),
    model_out,
    strrep("-", 60),
    tr("rep_footer", lang)
  )
  paste(out, collapse = "\n")
}

# Lectura robusta de ficheros de datos (CSV/TSV con coma o punto decimal).
# Sustituye a f.readfileauto.R: detecta separador, decimal y cabecera mirando
# las primeras líneas no vacías en lugar de solo los 20 primeros caracteres.

detect_format <- function(path, lang = "es") {
  lines <- readLines(path, n = 20, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
  lines <- sub("^\ufeff", "", lines)            # BOM de Excel
  lines <- lines[nzchar(trimws(lines))]
  if (!length(lines)) stop(tr("err_empty", lang), call. = FALSE)

  sep <- if (any(grepl(";", lines))) ";" else if (any(grepl("\t", lines))) "\t" else ","
  # Coma decimal solo es posible si el separador no es la coma
  dec <- if (sep != "," && any(grepl("[0-9],[0-9]", lines))) "," else "."
  header <- !grepl("^\\s*[-+]?[0-9.,]", lines[1])

  list(sep = sep, dec = dec, header = header)
}

read_ic50_data <- function(path, lang = "es") {
  fmt <- detect_format(path, lang)
  df <- utils::read.table(path, sep = fmt$sep, dec = fmt$dec, header = fmt$header,
                          blank.lines.skip = TRUE, fill = TRUE,
                          strip.white = TRUE, fileEncoding = "UTF-8")
  if (ncol(df) < 2) stop(tr("err_cols", lang), call. = FALSE)

  # Si existen columnas llamadas x e y se usan; si no, las dos primeras.
  nms <- tolower(names(df))
  cols <- if (all(c("x", "y") %in% nms)) match(c("x", "y"), nms) else 1:2
  out <- data.frame(x = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[cols[1]]])),
                    y = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df[[cols[2]]])))
  out <- out[stats::complete.cases(out), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  if (nrow(out) < 3) stop(tr("err_nobs", lang), call. = FALSE)
  attr(out, "format") <- fmt
  out
}
